verdict.rationale: Nitrokey documents FIDO2 support on the Nitrokey 3 and markets passwordless login to Microsoft services and Nextcloud. This implies the key can hold device-bound credentials, but the evidence never explicitly mentions discoverable/resident credentials or usernameless sign-in. missing for 10: explicit documentation of resident/discoverable credential storage, usernameless WebAuthn flow, credential capacity/management, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, the key stores discoverable FIDO2 credentials (resident keys / device-bound passkeys) so users can sign in to WebAuthn services without typing a username

citations.quote: The Nitrokey 3 combines the features of previous Nitrokey models: FIDO2
use Nitrokey for passwordless login instead
